7084-7422-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

950-2645-3257-3430.description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1939-3968-4050-4078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
1939-3968-4050-4078.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Luminous Phantom triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

141-997-1070.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-997-1070.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

628-2018-4465.description:
Activate Basal Sliver by sacrificing it.
When Basal Sliver dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Basal Sliver from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Basal Sliver by sacrificing it.
When Basal Sliver dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Basal Sliver from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat

3967-6566--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3967-6566--5--195.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4068-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1563-2457-4068-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1843-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1843-3259-4742.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a level counter on it

4644-5832-7791.description:
Activate Joraga Treespeaker by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Joraga Treespeaker.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Joraga Treespeaker.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7768.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

893-1558-4840-5496.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Myr.
893-1558-4840-5496.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it and five Myr, searching your library for Myr Battlesphere and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat each turn.

1061-1849-4603.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-1849-4603.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-1849-4603.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

622-4094-5702.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
622-4094-5702.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 5.

622-5702-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
622-5702-6753.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Shao Jun with "Pirate" chosen

4508-6310-7040.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
4508-6310-7040.description:
Activate Shao Jun by tapping two artifacts, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Repeat.
4508-6310-7040.notes: Once you have one opponent remaining, the loop fails to create enough Treasures to sustain itself. You may use other artifacts as desired or wait another turn until your artifacts are untapped. If you have more than two opponents, this combo will net Treasure(s) per loop, and those can also be used once you only have one opponent remaining.

1671-5702-6763-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
1671-5702-6763-6850.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

141-5686-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

2034-2363-4908-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

431-3129-4772-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-3129-4772-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

394-856-3899-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
394-856-3899-4321.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

5173-5553-5626-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
5173-5553-5626-6747.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1339-2292-6713.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional creature with flash and/or haste
1339-2292-6713.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature with haste or flash.
When the creature dies, Shadow triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

224-3177-3886.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {3}.
224-3177-3886.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Soratami Mirror Mage by paying {3} and returning the three lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Soratami Mirror-Mage abilities, returning any number of creatures from the battlefield to their owners' hands.
224-3177-3886.notes: You can repeat this loop as desired to constantly return creatures to their owner's hands as they enter the battlefield.

requires.n: Permanent with "You don't lose the game due to having 0 or less life"

13-2656--84.description:
Activate Selenia by paying 2 life.
Repeat step 2 until you have 0 life.
Resolve all Selenia abilities.
Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each opponent's life total to become 0.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 life.

1636-3143-5696-6166.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-5696-6166.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Oran-Rief Hydra trigger.
Resolve the Oran-Rief Hydra trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

225-851-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
225-851-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sicknes.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-851-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant each trigger twice.
Resolve the first Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 4 for the other Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

2099-2558-5123-5687.notablePrerequisites: You control no more than two additional creatures.
2099-2558-5123-5687.description:
Activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Jetmir, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1818-2452-3249-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

348-2178-2577-5477.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Priest of Forgotten Gods does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Zombie, and at least one additional creature except Gravecrawler or the Zombie.
348-2178-2577-5477.description:
Activate Priest of Forgotten Gods by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler and any other creature.
When the creatures die, Priest of Forgotten Gods triggers twice, untapping itself.
Resolve the Priest of Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, and causing you to add {B}{B} and draw a card.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Repeat.

4499-4605-5422-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking The Third Doctor.
When The Third Doctor enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, and Preston triggers twice if its power is 2 or less or once otherwise.
Resolve the The Third Doctor triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of The Third Doctor that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the The Third Doctor token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger, if applicable.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
4499-4605-5422-5542.notes: You may instead create Foods and/or Clues using The Third Doctor's triggers as long as you have mana available.

4050-5544-5618.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Rakdos triggers, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling the top card of the opponent's library with the ability to cast it until your next end step.
Repeat.

618-1872-4222.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Kiki-Jiki.
618-1872-4222.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate the Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

2034-4151-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {C}{C}.
When Vishgraz dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Vishgraz from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Vishgraz enters, it triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

890-2034-5003-5295.notablePrerequisites: Nim Deathmantle attached to Palladium Myr.
890-2034-5003-5295.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Palladium Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Palladium Myr dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Palladium Myr from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

15-643-1339-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
15-643-1339-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
